name: orgsync
description: Use current company guidance, agree contributions and review evidence across AI apps, with attributable human confirmation.

interface.shortDescription: Your company's approved context, with citations
interface.longDescription: OrgSync keeps your company's current decisions, goals and ways of working available across AI apps. Agree weekly contributions, distinguish manager assignments from recipient commitments, submit evidence and review results. Shared collaboration is readable by current company members. Exact human confirmation controls changes. Incoming requests never grant your consent. The web provides settings, read-only details and an agenda; discovery happens at your next check-in or through supported active sessions.
